name: cache-alert
description: A desktop notification shortly before a session's prompt cache goes cold, when that session is waiting on you and has a large context.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm after a response; the engine doesn't report it to mods.

minContextTokens.title: Smallest context worth an alert
minContextTokens.description: Below this many tokens of context, a cold cache is cheap to rebuild, so no alert.
